_comment: Hand-authored primitive register. A generator may write records that teach these. It may not add to this file. Admission criteria in docs/decisions/PRIMITIVE_REGISTER.md: directly observable, uncontested, not derivable from other entries, and accompanied by the observation that grounds it.

primitives.observation: An unsupported object moves downward.
The pushing happens before the moving, never after.
Pushing an object makes it move.
An object placed behind another is found there again.
The same object is not identical from one time to another.
An object can be damaged such that it no longer does what it did.
A broken object is not restored by the reverse of what broke it.
Repeated use changes an object even when nothing breaks.
An object can be separated into pieces.
When one piece fails, the assembled object may stop working.
Living things stop living.
A dead thing does not resume living.
Living things require food, water, and air, and fail without them.
Living things change in size and form over time.
Distinct objects can be matched one-to-one with number words.
The number words come in the same order every time.
Moving objects about does not change how many there are.
A part of a collection is fewer than the collection.
Putting more objects with a group makes the count larger.
Other people and animals move and change things on their own.
Another person may not know what you know.
Asking another person can tell you something you did not know.
What you are told sometimes does not match what you find.
Contact with some things causes injury.
Acting differently can prevent an injury that would otherwise occur.
Something can cause injury without appearing different from something that does not.
A person who has not been told, and has not been hurt, does not avoid the hazard.
Examining a thing reveals what was not known about it.
Acting on a thing reveals what examining it did not.
What is said about a thing either matches the thing or does not.
Looking again can settle a disagreement about what is so.
A drawing or a word is used in place of the thing it refers to.
A picture of a cup holds no water.
Two things can be alike in a way that matters and unlike in ways that do not.
